subject: Next steps & 30‑min intro — propose stakeholder timebands
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Garcia <sylvia.garcia@vantedge.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@vantedge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & 30‑min intro — propose stakeholder timebands

Hi Sylvia / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on the goals and the three initial success criteria (ingest speed, cost-per-query, and auditability). Quick recap + proposed next step below:

Recap (2 bullets)
- Primary use case: near‑real‑time clinical NLP over batch and streaming sources; initial scope — anomaly detection and summarization pipelines for trial sites.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent controls, retention & audit logs, and low-latency inference for clinician workflows.

Proposed next step: 30‑minute intro/demo with the right stakeholder trio (product + infra/security + procurement). To keep this light, we suggest a focused agenda: 10m context, 12m demo (30s feature highlights + live example), 8m Q&A/next actions.

Please pick one of these 3 timebands (all PT; we can convert for your team if needed):
1) Thu Aug 19 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (best for product owners)
2) Fri Aug 20 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT (preferred for engineering / infra)
3) Mon Aug 23 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT (flex for procurement + execs)

Who to include: product lead (Sylvia), engineering/infra SME (Carlos), and whoever owns procurement or legal (optional invite). If there’s a separate security/infosec contact you want involved, please add them and we’ll include a brief security slide.

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (short summary) and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) — I filled the first pass of milestones.

If none of those windows work, tell me two slots that do and we’ll lock one.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right folks aligned.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0192

Attachments: 20260812-discovery-notes.pdf (summary), RWI-2026-3482-MAP.xlsx (mutual action plan)
